nodes.label: Scheduling Conflict Resolution Strategy
nodes.rationale: Conflict resolution cascades through four states: FREE (slot open), ALTERNATIVES (free slots exist same day), SWAP_POSSIBLE (blocking client can be moved), NO_AVAILABILITY. This avoids double-booking while maximizing booking success rate.

nodes.label: Conversation History Ring Buffer
nodes.rationale: History is stored inside the context JSON column as _history (prefixed underscore marks it as protected). A cap of HISTORY_MAX_TURNS=10 trims oldest entries, providing LLM context without unbounded growth. Protected keys survive clear_context calls.
